summary: 4D Molecular Therapeutics filed a routine Item 8.01 8-K disclosing first patient enrollment in the 4SIGHT Phase 3 trial of 4D-150 for diabetic macular edema (N=514, aflibercept 2 mg Q8W comparator) and two-year SPECTRA data (N=22; Phase 3 dose n=9; +10.8 letters BCVA, -176 um CST; no intraocular inflammation). No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation or advisor is stated. The company cites FDA RMAT designation and FDA/EMA alignment on a single-trial BLA/MAA pathway. Watch clinical execution, safety, and regulatory filing timing; no deal or arbitrage angle.
